implementation: IBM COS Linux Kernel Cryptographic API Cryptographic Module (ECDSA_C)
description: The Linux kernel crypto API implementation provides cryptographic services to Linux kernel space software components and user space via the AF_ALG interface. The following cipher implementation is covered: Generic C non-optimized ECDSA signature operation.
